acme.advisor: advisor takes checkpoints, command, in_tool, max_calls, prompt, report_line (and report_on)
acme.advisories: advisories takes sources, alert and minutes
acme.asks: asks maps a name to {mark, label, command, deny}
acme.board-done-days: board_done_days is a whole number of days from 0 to 30
acme.bump-sequence: bump_sequence takes stages: [{name, intent, field, event, after}] and barrier: <stage>
acme.capacity: capacity takes test_needs_slot, audit_blocks_tests and waiting_holds_seat, each true or false
acme.companions-and-policy:
skills.yaml kickoff must be a mapping (read <tmp>/companions-and-policy/packs/acme/skills.yaml: 'router: router.md
cards:
  body: cards/body.md
  decompose:
  - work
  - test
  ')
acme.demo-login-origins: demo_login_origins is a list of origin names from staging.yaml, such as [app]
acme.environments: environments is a list of {name, origins, slot}
acme.forge: forge takes bots, bump_batch, bump_push_prefix, bumps_shipped_only, discover_prs, host, human_emails, human_login, kind, local, mention_tags, org, ready_labels, rereview_at_once, rereview_job, review_labels, skip_outdated, tagged_comments_only
acme.hours: hours.standup: a time is a whole hour or HH:MM, not '25:99'
acme.ide: ide.command must be a list of strings
acme.kickoff: kickoff takes lanes: {mode: seat kind}, preflight: {mode: [steps]} and done_rows: developed
acme.lanes: lanes takes by_slot and browser_session: true or false
acme.mcp-servers: mcp_servers docs: a command or a url, not both
acme.outbox: outbox takes auto: [{scope, types}], amend_on_treat, ci_rework_chain, comment_card, missing_skill, ci_override, supersede_reviews and sweep_passes
acme.pack-and-repos: watchers takes limits, base and ci
acme.plugins: plugins maps another plugin's name to its block
acme.prompts: prompts maps a lowercase name to a file path
acme.protected-branches: protected_branches must be a list of branch names
acme.records-dir: records_dir must be a folder inside the workspace
acme.refused: refused, allowed, and privileged must be mappings
acme.skills-intent:
skills.yaml intent must be a mapping (read <tmp>/skills-intent/packs/acme/skills.yaml: 'router: router.md
kickoff:
  intake:
  - analyze-ticket
  - cockpit:outbox
  rev')
acme.skills-kickoff:
skills.yaml kickoff must be a mapping (read <tmp>/skills-kickoff/packs/acme/skills.yaml: 'router: router.md
cards:
  body: cards/body.md
  decompose:
  - work
  - test
  ')
acme.testflow-key: testflow takes never_write, run_dir and review_mark (and, optionally, send_back, test_run_posts, attach, title, banners, evidence_dir, plan_file and results_file)
acme.testflow-run-dir: testflow.run_dir is a folder name with {n} (or {n:03d})
acme.ticket-pattern: ticket_pattern: missing ), unterminated subpattern at position 0
acme.tracker-kind: tracker.kind is one of connector, jira, command, local, github-issues
acme.two-late-and-early: ticket_pattern: missing ), unterminated subpattern at position 0
acme.watchers: watchers takes limits, base and ci
acme.worktree-gc: worktree_gc holds enabled and days only
